title: Super cute, but not my favorite
text: Super cute, but not my favorite. I don't know about everyone else, but in my house, I am constantly losing my pot holders, so I am always in the market for new ones. I thought these were really cute, and they totally are, but I don't really love them. The material is really stiff, and not the most comfortable when using. Also the shapes, which cute, are not the most functional. The pumpkin is fine, and I use it all the time, but the ghost is another story. The ghost thins at the top, and splits because of the arms, but if you have a larger hand (or really even a normal sized hand) its not easy/comfortable to put your hand all the way in to use to grab things out of the oven. So cute, looks good in the kitchen if you decorate for fall/Halloween, but not all that practical in the long term.
